# Camp Resource: Mothman Moth Sanctuary

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Jul 24, 2024
- 2 min read

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_c4e0268f1c0a4c639813b586cd6791ac~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

Build a menacing Mothman Moth Sanctuary to escape the wasteland for a moment.

Generates acid.

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter. Also comes with a static version that can be placed in shelters.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Mothman Butterfly Sanctuary__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_e4edcaff8d3c4109b5c5e3fdda558a40~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit: __SugarBombsRADS__

**Produces**

Acid

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

Butterfly Sanctuary (resource item)

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

*Static Version

Floor Decor - shares a build limit with several other items, including the Mothman Moth Sanctuary, Butterfly Sanctuary, Vulture Post, Raven Post, Owl Cage, and Red Cardinal Cage. You are allowed to have up to three of these items combined.

**Holds**

10 Acid

**Obtainable via**

Atom Shop - __Mothman Moth Sanctuary__ - 700 atoms

**Produces X amount per**

Every 10 minutes and 12 seconds

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

None

#### **Flamingo Units**

2 Flamingo Units

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_37a8ee666027440d97d4c2ae0b5393e1~mv2.png)
